title: Keep the service day: a constructed overnight timetable handoff
summary: Ten literal-reference time calculations and five unresolved/inactive examples retain dates, zones and source assumptions. Bureau-owned sample; no real timetable or outside result.

content.method: Interpret S1 literally: convert service-date noon in the agency zone to UTC, subtract 43,200 seconds, then add the extended-hour value in seconds. Only afterward convert the instant to a local display.
content.scope: Independent illustrative events, not trips or a complete GTFS feed. No real service availability asserted.

findings: T03 retains service_date=20261007 while its local event falls on 2026-10-08.
T08 and T09 display 02:30 with different UTC offsets and instants one hour apart.
T07/T08 and T09/T10 respectively share instants but retain different service dates. Do not infer duplicate trips from timestamps alone.
U01-U03/U05 remain unresolved; U04 is inactive by constructed assumption. No missing value is invented.
